lines.text: 走一步，或者跳过一颗珠子。
可以连着跳；十颗珠子先进对面三角就赢。
一颗，又一颗——整条路都通了。
悔棋、提示，也都替你想好了。
星跃，十颗玻璃珠，跨过一片星空。离线，无广告。
Weekend night. One game of checkers.
Move one step, or jump a marble.
Chain your jumps. Fill the far triangle to win.
One jump, another, another — the whole route opens up.
Play solo, or share one screen.
Undo and hints are there when you need them.
Star Leap. Ten glass marbles. One starry board. Offline, no ads.
